title: prompt override hardening
lead: `slicer check` stops warning about dotfiles in `.slicer/prompts/`, and a test proves that `ai set NAME --stdin` reads the raw byte stream and refuses non-UTF-8 bytes with code `io`.
findings_note: Deferred `later` follow-ups from the s437 relay review (release 1.18.0), 2026-11-02: check warns on dotfiles in `.slicer/prompts/`, and no test feeds non-UTF-8 bytes through a buffered stdin to `ai set --stdin`.
boundary: **Not in this slice:** any other check warning; the `--file` path (already covered by `test_AiSet_NonUtf8OrMissingFile_IsIoAndWritesNothing`); `template set --stdin`, which keeps reading `sys.stdin.read()`; changing the `io` code or exit 3 for non-UTF-8 input.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Verified against main at 50bd033 on 2026-11-02:

1. `check._prompt_warnings` (src/slicer/check.py:99-117) walks `state.prompts_dir.glob("*")`, which matches dotfiles, and warns "unknown prompt file" for every regular file not named `build-roadmap.md` or `getting-started.md`. In a scratch project, `printf x > .slicer/prompts/.DS_Store` made `slicer check --json` report that warning (ok stays true). Finder's `.DS_Store`, editor swap files such as `.getting-started.md.swp`, and the `.slicer-tmp-*` file `jsonio.write_bytes` creates for a moment are all dotfiles and are never prompts. Rule: skip any entry whose name starts with `.`. Undotted unknown files still warn (`test_Check_UnknownPromptFile_Warns`), and conflict-marker detection on known names is unchanged.
2. `cli._template_source` (cli.py:3379-3395) reads a prompt from `sys.stdin.buffer.read().decode("utf-8")` when stdin has a `buffer`, else `sys.stdin.read()`. `test_AiSet_NonUtf8Stdin_IsIoAndWritesNothing` (tests/test_ai_prompt_command.py:122) patches stdin with a `BadStdin` class that has no `buffer` and whose `read()` raises, so it only exercises the fallback branch. `test_AiSet_BufferedStdin_PreservesUtf8AndCrLf` (line 69) does use a real `io.TextIOWrapper(io.BytesIO(...))` but only with valid UTF-8. Nothing proves invalid bytes on the buffered path give `io`. To make the test fail if the buffer path were dropped, wrap the bytes in a TextIOWrapper with `encoding="latin-1"`: its `read()` would succeed and write a file, so only the buffer path refuses.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `src/slicer/check.py`: in `_prompt_warnings`, skip a path whose name starts with `.` before the `is_file` test. Update the docstring to say so.
- `tests/test_ai_prompt_command.py`: the two tests below, reusing `self.repo()`, `self.error()`, `_tracking_bytes()` and `check_warning`'s setup.
- `docs/configuration.md` (the prompts paragraph, ~line 314): "`check` warns on unknown files or conflict markers" gains "(dotfiles are ignored)".
- `CHANGELOG.md` under `## [Unreleased]` `### Fixed`.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `test_Check_DotfileInPrompts_IsIgnored`: with a valid override seeded and `.DS_Store` and `.getting-started.md.swp` written under `.slicer/prompts/`, after `render`, `check --json` exits 0, `ok` is true and no warning names either file. Fails today on `.DS_Store`.
- `test_AiSet_NonUtf8OnBufferedStdin_IsIoAndWritesNothing`: patch `slicer.cli.sys.stdin` with `io.TextIOWrapper(io.BytesIO(b"# facts \xff\xfe\n"), encoding="latin-1")`; `ai set getting-started --stdin --json` exits 3 with error code `io`, the message names stdin, no `.slicer/prompts/getting-started.md` exists and `_tracking_bytes` is unchanged. This passes on today's code (it pins the buffer path); mutation-check it by changing the prompt branch in `_template_source` to `sys.stdin.read()`, which must make it fail.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write both tests; confirm the check test fails and the stdin test fails under the mutation.
2. Add the dotfile skip in `_prompt_warnings`.
3. Docs and CHANGELOG.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- [ ] `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t tests -k '*DotfileInPrompts*'` and `-k '*NonUtf8OnBufferedStdin*'` pass; `-k '*PromptFile*'` and `-k '*ConflictMarkers*'` still pass.
- [ ] In a scratch project, a `.DS_Store` under `.slicer/prompts/` gives no `check` warning and `other.md` still does.
- [ ] `python3 tests/affected.py --run`, the full suite, `slicer check` and `git diff --check` pass.
